TASK N1-002  CRITICAL  Upgrade operations/work-orders/page.tsx
  File: app/(app)/(enterprise)/operations/work-orders/page.tsx
  Current: Uses workOrdersApi from lib/ (old pattern), old SearchInput
  Fix: Rewrite using standard pattern:
       PageWrapper > PageHeader > KPI strip > StatusFilterTabs
       > ActionBar > DataTable > Pagination
       Use: fetch /api/v1/work-orders/ (proxy rewrite)
       Use: StatusBadge, Avatar, Progress, toast
  This is the most visited operations page
  Time: 1 hour

TASK N1-003  HIGH  Fix work-orders/new/page.tsx CSS variables
  File: app/(app)/(enterprise)/operations/work-orders/new/page.tsx
  Bug: Uses var(--tb-surface-elevated), var(--tb-border) etc
       These CSS variables are NOT defined in globals.css
       Form renders with broken styles in production
  Fix: Replace all var(--tb-*) with Tailwind classes:
       --tb-surface-elevated -> bg-white
       --tb-border           -> border-slate-200
       --tb-text-primary     -> text-slate-900
       --tb-danger           -> text-red-500
  Also: Wire to real /api/v1/work-orders/ POST endpoint
  Also: Use Input/Textarea/Button components from ui/
  Time: 1.5 hours

TASK N3-001  CRITICAL  Add JWT auth to enterprise API endpoints
  Ref: PR-010 from production readiness audit
  Files to update:
    src/commercial/maintenance_enterprise/router.py
    src/commercial/analytics_platform/router.py
    src/commercial/approval_center/router.py
    src/commercial/customer_success/router.py
    src/commercial/projects/router.py
    src/commercial/executive_intelligence/router.py
  Pattern for each router:
    from src.core.auth import get_current_user
    from src.commercial.auth.models import User
    Add to each endpoint: current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
  Test: curl http://localhost:8030/api/v1/maintenance/dashboard
        Without token -> 401 Unauthorized
        With token    -> 200 OK
  Time: 2 hours

TASK N3-002  HIGH  Add rate limiting on login endpoint
  Ref: PR-011 from production readiness audit
  File: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ai-company-os
  Add rate zone:
    limit_req_zone dollar_binary_remote_addr zone=auth:10m rate=5r/m;
  Apply to auth location:
    location /api/v1/auth/login {
      limit_req zone=auth burst=3 nodelay;
      proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8030;
    }
  Test: 6 rapid login attempts -> 429 Too Many Requests
  Time: 30 minutes

TASK N3-003  HIGH  Add Content Security Policy
  Ref: PR-012 from production readiness audit
  File: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ai-company-os
  Add header:
    add_header Content-Security-Policy
    "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval';
     style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:;
     font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com;
     connect-src 'self' http://localhost:8030 http://localhost:8001;";
  Reload: sudo nginx -t && sudo nginx -s reload
  Time: 30 minutes

TASK N3-004  MEDIUM  Remove framer-motion from bundle
  Ref: PR-013 (partially done - axios removed)
  Verify: grep -r 'framer-motion' portal/app portal/components | grep import
  If zero imports: npm uninstall framer-motion
  Expected bundle savings: ~50KB gzipped
  Time: 15 minutes

    test 3: StatusBadge renders correct className for each status
    test 4: Pagination does not render when totalPages <= 1
    test 5: SearchInput shows clear button when value present
    test 6: Button shows loading spinner when loading=true
    test 7: EmptyState renders title and action
    test 8: DataTable renders correct number of rows
  Add to package.json: 'test': 'jest', 'test:coverage': 'jest --coverage'
  Target: 8 tests passing, coverage report generated
  Time: 4 hours

TASK N6-001  HIGH  Add database backup cron
  Ref: INFRA-004 from production readiness audit
  Create: /home/amr/AI-COMPANY-OS/scripts/backup_db.sh
    pg_dump triangle_black -> /home/amr/AI-COMPANY-OS/backups/db_YYYYMMDD.sql
    Keep 7 days, delete older
  Schedule: crontab -e -> 0 2 * * * bash .../backup_db.sh
  Time: 30 minutes

TASK N6-002  HIGH  Create systemd service for TB Admin
  Ref: INFRA-002 from production readiness audit
  File: /etc/systemd/system/tb-admin.service
  Content:
    [Unit] Description=Triangle Black Admin API
    [Service] WorkingDirectory=.../triangle-black
              ExecStart=.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8030
              Restart=always
    [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target
  Enable: sudo systemctl enable tb-admin
  Time: 30 minutes

TASK N6-003  MEDIUM  PWA manifest.json
  File: portal/public/manifest.json
  Content: name, short_name, icons, theme_color, display: standalone
  File: portal/app/layout.tsx - add manifest link
  Result: Portal installable as app on mobile and desktop
  Time: 1 hour

TASK N6-004  MEDIUM  Offline detection banner
  Hook: lib/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts
    window.addEventListener('online'/'offline')
    Returns: isOnline boolean
  Component: add to EnterpriseShell
    When offline: amber banner at top 'You appear to be offline'
    When back online: dismiss + toast.success('Back online')
  Time: 1 hour

TASK N6-005  LOW  Dark mode foundation
  All CSS tokens already defined - just need dark: variants
  Add to globals.css:
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) or .dark class {
      --color-bg: #0f172a;
      --color-surface: #1e293b;
      --color-text-1: #f1f5f9;
      etc
    }
  Add: dark mode toggle button to EnterpriseTopbar
  Time: 3 hours
